[SWS_CM_80004] Byte order for signal-based network binding with signal-based serialization
⌈
If SomeipEventDeployment.serializer is set to
signalBased then
the byte order of the parameters inside the payload shall be defined by the respective
packingByteOrder of ISignalToIPduMapping and
by the packingByteOrder of PduToFrameMapping.
⌋
